method: Bytes of each staged installer (stage-release-assets.sh output), checked by scripts/check-artifact-size.mjs in the desktop artifact smoke for the nightly and the release build.
ratchet: Baseline: the v2.5.0 release assets (2026-10-29), except the AppImages, which come from the dev build of 2026-10-30 (#2914 added the GStreamer video plugins after v2.5.0: x64 158.2 MB, arm64 151.8 MB), and the Windows installers and .deb packages, which come from the v2.9.0 dry run (2026-11-12; #3250 added the 885 KB Silero speech-detection model after v2.5.0: x64-setup 8.81 MB, arm64-setup 8.12 MB, amd64.deb 26.14 MB, arm64.deb 25.55 MB). Budget = baseline + 3 %, rounded up to the next 100 KB. One-time exception (owner decision, 2026-11-12): every budget is baseline + 2.41 MB for the bundled Twemoji emoji images (eight SVG packs and nine picker sheets, 2.41 MB as the desktop build compresses them), then + 3 %. Raise of 2026-11-13: the Windows budgets go up by 300 KB for the second Silero speech model (silero-v6.2.0-slim.bin, 491 KB on disk and about 460 KB as an installer compresses it); the Linux packages take it inside their budgets. Raise of 2026-11-26: the linux-arm64 .deb goes from 28,800,000 to 29,600,000 B (+2.8 %) because the dispatched Desktop Artifact Smoke measured it at 28,877,138 B (77,138 B over) after the client grew since the 2026-11-12 baseline; in the same run the amd64 .deb (29,472,322 B), x64-setup.exe (11,886,543 B) and arm64-setup.exe (11,189,109 B) had under 30 KB left, so they rise too: amd64.deb 29,500,000 to 30,300,000 B (+2.7 %), x64-setup.exe 11,900,000 to 12,200,000 B (+2.5 %), arm64-setup.exe 11,200,000 to 11,500,000 B (+2.7 %). A raise goes up by at most 3 % and says why in its PR; a PR that shrinks an installer lowers its budget. Phase Q4 goal: 20 % below the v2.5.0 size.
